thread:
asha: heads-up — Glenhaven (acct: sableton) reporting p99 spikes on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings since ~09:20 UTC. customer seeing intermittent 500s and long tails. logs show `queue_wait_ms` hitting ~8000ms.
maya: is this tenant-scoped or platform-wide?
jordan: tenant-scoped. redis queue for tenant `sableton` has a backlog. saw a burst of bulk-embed jobs from api-key `s-sableton-batch` starting 09:18. looks like a noisy neighbor/large batch flood.
leo: runtime note — their embed jobs spawn a bulk-worker pool that bypasses normal request batching and pushes many concurrent reservations. possible reservation leak + semaphore saturation on shard us-west-2-a.
asha: customer says they didn’t change anything on their side. repro they sent:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer s-sableton-batch" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-compact-1","input":["...large list of docs..."]}'
```

maya: thanks — want to give them a mitigation while we investigate. they asked about a temporary priority lane / allowlist.
jordan: metrics: p95 from ~120ms -> 980ms, p99 up to 4200ms. reservation semaphores on several workers >90%. node mem/CPU not crazy, so it's queue/backpressure.
leo: short-term: two options — 1) set per-tenant max_concurrency to throttle their burst, or 2) create ephemeral reservation and route them to reserved pool (fastest).
asha: can we do a quick throttle change before provisioning infra? low-risk config flip would buy time.
jordan: yes — admin CLI patch: `admin tenant update --id sableton --max_concurrency 8` this will cap concurrent reservations and smooth the tail.
leo: I'll prepare reservation if CS wants it. suggested: ephemeral reservation rsv-<auto> with 2 x g4dn-like units in us-west-2-a for 12h.
maya: customer ok with temporary reservation + throttle. they want rollback steps documented.
leo: rollback/remove: `admin tenant update --id sableton --max_concurrency 100` and `admin reservations cancel --id rsv-4391` (drain first, then cancel).
opsbot: deploy-bot: created reservation rsv-4391 for tenant `sableton` in us-west-2-a. TTL=12h. routed traffic to reserved pool.
jordan: after reservation creation p99 dropped to ~700ms within ~3 minutes. created monitor `/alerts/sableton-tail` and a 60m watch window.
asha: putting together a short note to the customer: explain cause (bursty bulk embed -> reservation saturation), list mitigations we applied (throttle + ephemeral reservation), and follow-ups (investigate reservation leak pattern, rate-limit bulk endpoints, longer-term safelist/reserved seat options).
maya: customer update sent, they're relieved. will loop back if they see recurrence.
asha: thanks team :thumbsup:
leo: follow-ups — I'll dig into bulk-worker logs for `s-sableton-batch` and check for orphaned reservations. tagging @jordan for metrics alert tuning.
jordan: ack — will refine semaphore thresholds and add a synthetic test to catch bulk spiky workloads.
opsbot: note: ticket #CS-4821 created linking logs + reservation + graphs.
asha: closing thread for now, will reopen if customer reoccurs.
